versions.changelog:
Merge pull request #4 from Jacob-Lasky/images-follow-the-item

Carry an item's images to its replacement (1.4.0.0)

An item removed while Jellyfin was still refreshing it stays removed.

- When a metadata refresh that was still running as the plugin removed an item saved it back (with no parent: invisible in the library, never visited by a scan, but found by search), the plugin now removes it again within seconds. It watches every removal for 30 minutes, also looking at 1, 10 and 29 minutes for saves that raise no event.
- When a file exists at that path again (a re-import overwritten by the stale save), the plugin reconciles the path instead, so the item is listed again with its parent. An import over such a row also re-creates it properly.

Merged versions and in-library imports.

- An item merged as a version of another (Merge Versions, or Jellyfin's own merge) is found by its path and removed when its file goes; before, it stayed until the next library scan.
- An import that moves a file from inside the library (a manual import of a stray copy) removes the old item, and hands its watch state and links to the imported one when both are the same title.
- Skipped paths (every import's download folder) log at Debug.

Search stays current.

- Items this plugin adds or changes (and the seasons and episodes of a new series) are written to the Meilisearch plugin's search index within seconds, with that plugin's own connection settings and document shape. Nothing else is indexed and no full reindex is run.
- Each written document is checked again after 45 seconds, 3 and 15 minutes, so one a concurrent rebuild swapped away is written again, and one left for a removed item is deleted.
- Writes retry with backoff for an hour while Meilisearch is down.
- Off switch on the settings page.

First release.

- Sonarr and Radarr Webhook connections post to /ArrRefresh/Webhook.
- Imports, upgrades, renames and deletes update only the affected movie, series, season or episode. A library root is never refreshed.
- Replaced items hand their watch state, playlist entries and collection memberships to their successors, including every episode of a series that moved folders.
- Nothing is removed while its file exists or its share is offline.
- POST /ArrRefresh/Paths runs the same work on demand.

name: Arr Refresh
overview: Sonarr/Radarr webhooks update only the movie or episode that changed, never the whole library.
description: Point Sonarr's and Radarr's stock Webhook connection at /ArrRefresh/Webhook. On import, upgrade, rename and delete, the plugin resolves only the affected path: it creates or replaces the movie (or the series) under its existing parent, removes items whose files are gone, carries watch state, collection membership and images across a rename, and queues a metadata refresh for that item alone. Episodes refresh only their Season. Nothing ever re-validates a library root, so large libraries on slow or union filesystems are not walked on every change.
